canonicalDecomposition.expression: source cut sign * (canonical stiffness row dot native local DISP - consistent fixed-end load)
canonicalDecomposition.termOrder: Increasing stiffness-row column index, then input packet distributed-load order.
canonicalDecomposition.structuralTerms: Include every nonzero stiffness coefficient even when its displacement is zero. Include each nonzero fixed-end-load contribution separately. No merging, thresholding, or algebraic rewriting.
canonicalDecomposition.shearAreas: Asy=Asz=5*A/6: published convention and response-checked hypothesis, not a raw native scalar readback.
canonicalDecomposition.geometry: Length from the source-oriented float32 SDATA endpoints; principal-axis basis from the validated physical packet.

limits: A new conservative engineering comparison policy; the acceptance region changes.
Keep authored strict-tolerance results separately; native values and tolerances are unchanged.
This is an analytical recovery scale, not a proved vendor arithmetic error bound.
Vendor internal stiffness, operation ordering and factorization precision are unobserved.
No input-error, displacement-quantization or observed-discrepancy allowance is added.
Only raw member endpoint requests are covered; node translations, reactions and derived quantities are excluded.
Only reviewed principal axes, fixed bases, uniform line loads, first-order linear response, and a single native DL selection are supported.
